label: Tab Unloader
Timing
Turn on automatic unloading *Frees the memory a tab is using after it sits untouched. The tab stays in your sidebar and reloads when you click it. Nothing is closed.*
Unload after (seconds) *How long a tab sits untouched before it gets unloaded. 1800 is 30 minutes. Set it to 10 while testing, then put it back.*
Check every (seconds) *How often to look for tabs to unload. 60 is fine for everyday use. Lower it while testing.*
Unload at most this many at once *Stops a big batch unloading in one go, which can stutter.*
Always keep this many tabs loaded *A safety floor so a long session never ends up with everything unloaded.*
Never unload
Essentials *Your Essentials tabs stay loaded so they open instantly.*
Pinned tabs *Separate from Essentials.*
Anything playing sound *Music and video keep playing.*
Tabs with a notification *Tabs Firefox has flagged as wanting your attention.*
Tabs where you have typed something *Protects half-filled forms. Needs SessionStore; if it is unavailable the check is skipped rather than keeping every tab.*
Calls and screen sharing *Unloading these would drop the call.*
Picture-in-picture *Unloading closes the floating video window.*
Glance tabs *Zen's Glance overlay.*
Split view tabs *Both halves are on screen.*
Never unload sites containing *Comma separated, for example: mail.google.com, localhost. Leave empty to skip this.*
Troubleshooting

Log what it is doing *Prints each sweep to the Browser Console (Ctrl+Shift+J). Also gives you TabUnloader.status() for a per-tab list with the reason each one was kept, and TabUnloader.settings() to confirm the settings actually reached the script.*
